why: Both proposals use the same tan leather sofa instead of the mustard velvet the client asked for, so that miss cancels out. A's palette is more cohesive: the blue and red woven cushions, wood coffee table and linen-shade lamp all echo the rug, and they suit the warm parquet floor. B's folk-print cushions are livelier and closer to the 'alegre' brief, but its small carved drum table and plain white modern lamp clash with the rest of the look.
